topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone got my artwork tattooed on their skin. I mean, on one hand, it’s flattering, right? They liked my work so much... But I didn’t give permission. What if they got it wrong, or it’s not how I meant it to be? It’s my creation, and now it’s out there permanently, not just as a piece that can be framed and taken down. I’m not sure how to feel about it. Should I be honored, or do I have a right to be upset? I’ve been thinking about this all day, and I can’t shake the unease.
